entities.summary: Mikhail Aleksandrovich Bonch-Bruevich, sometimes spelled Bonch-Bruyevich, was an engineer, scientist, and professor. Generally considered the leading authority on radio in Russian Empire and Soviet Union in the first decades of the 20th century, he greatly influenced the pre-radar development of radio-location in that nation.
